activity.role: Goryeo commander at the Battle of Hwangsan
activity.notes: Yi Seong-gye, later Taejo of Joseon, commanded Goryeo forces against Japanese pirates at the Battle of Hwangsan in September 1380, before he established Joseon in 1392. The Activity links to existing Goryeo (not Joseon), representing only the documented 1380 campaign, without inventing a full continuous military-service interval.
